name: Deferred Surface Splatting
aliases: EWA surface splatting with deferred shading
definition: A rendering technique that converts unstructured point clouds into continuous shaded surfaces by projecting points as splats into a deferred rendering pipeline (G-buffers for depth, normals, and color/weight), followed by a final shading pass over a screen quad.
summary: Deferred Surface Splatting renders point clouds as shaded surfaces by projecting splats into a G-buffer and deferring lighting to a final pass, trading accurate filtering for efficiency.
